pets.name: Luna
pets.description: Luna is a calm little lady who loves sunny windows and long naps. She will sit on your keyboard while you code.

pets.name: Max
pets.description: Max has never met a stranger. He loves fetch, swimming, and stealing socks.

pets.name: Kiwi
pets.description: Kiwi can say 'hello', 'pizza' and, sadly, the sound of a microwave.

pets.name: Coco
pets.description: Coco has floppy ears and a big appetite for carrots. Does a happy jump called a 'binky'.

pets.name: Rocky
pets.description: Rocky is a senior gentleman who just wants a soft bed and someone to walk with.
pets.reason: Every old man deserves a good friend

pets.name: Shadow
pets.description: Shadow is shy at first, then follows you from room to room like... a shadow.

pets.name: Sunny
pets.description: Sunny sings every morning at 7am. Free alarm clock included!

pets.name: Bella
pets.description: Bella is fancy, smart and knows 12 tricks. Treats are her love language.

pets.name: Oreo
pets.description: Oreo is black and white like the cookie, and just as sweet. Loves running around the house.

pets.name: Ginger
pets.description: Ginger is the boss of the shelter. Will knock things off tables to get your attention.
